questionTemplate: Will it rain in Lagos on {{date}}?
rulesTemplate: Observation period: the Lagos calendar day {{date}}, 00:00 to 24:00 WAT (UTC+1). Resolves YES if the NiMet daily weather report for Lagos for {{date}} records measurable rain, otherwise NO. Trading closes at the start of that day, 00:00 WAT = {{cutoffUtc}}. A trusted resolver (the market's resolver_id) sets the final result once, after the cutoff and after the NiMet report is published. There is no VOID or dispute path.

evidence.description: Link to or quotation of the NiMet daily weather report for the observation date
